> 第5章 后山抓蛇（第1页）
“大春，你抓蛇小心一点，现在蛇还未冬眠，山上可不少呢！被毒蛇咬了，可就不好了。”师娘杨桃花关心道。
“师娘，你放心吧，我会注意的。”柳大春说着就往后山而去。
芙蓉村的后山乃非祥之地，后山深处连接整个麒麟山脉，连绵不绝，海拔极高，像一座天然的屏障。
屏障的那头是邻省，但是那边是悬崖峭壁，基本上过不了。
这也就是导致了整个麒麟山脉保持着原始森林的生态，里面更是仙鹤云游，万物森罗，甚至还有传闻，乃仙神修仙之地。
芙蓉村也是沾了这点福气，万物都灵气十足。
柳大春爬到后山时，就开始寻找起来。
这次觉醒伏羲阴术，其中就有伏羲阴眼，这伏羲阴眼可真是天地精灵之气，可透视可感知万物还可拉远视野，千里眼一般。
同时，这伏羲阴眼分九级，每三级一个境界，每升一个境界，可开启更强大的阴瞳之术，比如第二境，具备魅惑之力。
柳大春很快就到了后山，寻找起蛇了。
柳大春本身领悟的伏羲正阴，正是喜阴的锦鳞蚺的阴图腾。
如今这锦鳞蚺在柳大春的体内，似乎和山上的蛇类形成了共鸣。
柳大春循着这种共鸣而去，便发现了一个山洞。
这个山洞洞口茂盛，挂着水珠，非常潮湿，柳大春便小心翼翼的走了进去，果然，发现了几条竹叶青。
这竹叶青有毒，被咬会致幻，严重了也会致命。
柳大春一把抓住了蛇的七寸，放入了麻袋里，这一抓就是三条。
这镇上的人，对蛇有种莫名的崇拜，说这蛇能治百病，男人服用蛇酒补肾壮阳，女人服用，那也是补精养宫之圣品，所以价格特别高。
柳大春乐着出了山洞，这时，听见边上的草丛有男女之声。

柳大春好奇的钻入了草丛，拨开一看，靠，一对男女，正在忙着干活。
这对男女柳大春认识，男的是上屋老吴，女的正是他的媳妇。
看见这个老吴，柳大春其实是火冒三丈的。
这老色逼曾来家里欲欺负师娘，最后和柳大春还打了起来。
老吴后来还报复过柳大春，在他的菜里下了毒，让柳大春变成一个不举的傻子。
这见到老吴，分外眼红，往事一幕幕，复仇之心涌上心头。
这时，柳大春的身影被看见了，老吴大喊了一声，便急忙站了起来查看。
“傻大春？是你？你在这偷看什么？”老吴一见是傻大春，就骂道。
“抓蛇？”老吴看了傻大春的箩筐一眼，说道：“没经过我老吴的同意，你就来这后山抓蛇？你不知道这后山是老子的吗？”
“这后山怎么会是你的呢？”柳大春不解的问。
“这后山是我和赵村长一起承包的，怎么不是我的？？你在我的地盘抓蛇，你经过我同意了吗？”老吴强词夺理道。
这时，老吴的媳妇也起身走了过来。
柳大春看了老吴的媳妇一眼，这婶婶四十多岁，熟女气息泛滥，又是柳大春喜欢的类型。

> Chapter 5 Catching Snakes in the Back Mountain (Page 1)
"Dachun, be careful when catching snakes. There are many snakes on the mountain before they hibernate! If you are bitten by a poisonous snake, it will not be good." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said with concern.
"Master's wife, don't worry, I will pay attention." Liu Dachun said and walked towards the back mountain.
The back mountain of Furong Village is an auspicious place. The depth of the back mountain connects to the entire Qilin Mountain Range. It is continuous and extremely high in altitude, like a natural barrier.
On the other side of the barrier is the neighboring province, but there are cliffs on the other side that are basically impossible to cross.
This has led to the entire Qilin Mountains maintaining the ecology of a primeval forest. There are cranes roaming around, all things dense, and there are even rumors that it is a place where immortals and gods cultivate themselves.
Furong Village is also blessed with this blessing, and everything is full of aura.
When Liu Dachun climbed to the back mountain, he began to search.
This time I awakened Fuxi's Yin Technique, which included Fuxi's Yin Eyes. This Fuxi's Yin Eyes is really the energy of the spirits of heaven and earth. It can see through, perceive all things, and also extend the field of vision, just like clairvoyance.
At the same time, Fuxi's Yin Eyes are divided into nine levels, with each third level leading to a realm. Each level up can unlock more powerful Yin Eye techniques, such as the second level, which has the power of charm.
Liu Dachun soon arrived at the back mountain and started looking for snakes.
The Fuxi Zhengyin that Liu Dachun himself understood is exactly the Yin totem of the Yin-loving Jin-scaled Anaconda.
Now that the golden-scaled anaconda was in Liu Dachun's body, it seemed to resonate with the snakes on the mountain.
Liu Dachun followed this resonance and found a cave.
The cave entrance was lush, with water droplets hanging on it, and it was very humid. Liu Dachun walked in carefully, and sure enough, he found several green bamboo leaves.
This bamboo leaf green is poisonous. If bitten, it will cause hallucinations. In severe cases, it can be fatal.
Liu Dachun grabbed seven inches of the snake and put it into the sack. There were three snakes in his grasp.
People in this town have an inexplicable worship of snakes, saying that snakes can cure all diseases. Men take snake wine to nourish the kidneys and strengthen yang, and women take it. It is also a holy product to nourish the essence and nourish the palace, so the price is particularly high.
Liu Dachun came out of the cave happily. At this time, he heard the voices of men and women in the grass beside him.
Liu Dachun got into the grass curiously, and when he opened it, he saw a man and a woman busy working.
The man and woman Liu Dachun knew each other. The man was Lao Wu from Shangwu, and the woman was his wife.
Seeing this old Wu, Liu Dachun was actually furious.
This old pervert once came to the house to bully the teacher's wife, and finally got into a fight with Liu Dachun.
Lao Wu later took revenge on Liu Dachun and poisoned his food, turning Liu Dachun into a fool who refused to eat.
Seeing Lao Wu now, he was extremely jealous. The past scenes showed him, and the desire for revenge surged into his heart.
At this time, Liu Dachun's figure was seen. Old Wu shouted and hurriedly stood up to check.
"Silly Dachun? Is that you? What are you peeking at here?" Old Wu cursed when he saw it was Silly Dachun.
"Catch snakes?" Old Wu glanced at Silly Dachun's basket and said, "Without my consent, Old Wu, you come to this back mountain to catch snakes? Don't you know that this back mountain belongs to me?"
"How come this back mountain belongs to you?" Liu Dachun asked puzzledly.
"This back mountain was contracted by Village Chief Zhao and I, so why isn't it mine?? You are catching snakes on my property. Did you get my consent?" Old Wu said eloquently.
At this time, Lao Wu's wife also got up and walked over.
Liu Dachun glanced at Lao Wu's wife. This aunt was in her forties and had a mature air. She was Liu Dachun's favorite type.
